checks.text: With no check-ins, the page shows the heading "Goal Tracker", the text "No check-ins yet", the streak line "Current streak: 0 days", and the progress ring label "0/30".
Clicking the button "Check in today" adds a check-in for today, updates the streak line to "Current streak: 1 day", and changes the progress ring label to "1/30".

After clicking "Check in today" once, clicking the button "Add past check-in" opens a date input; typing "2023-10-15" in the field labelled "Date" and clicking "Save" adds a check-in for that date, and the heatmap shows a filled cell for October 15, 2023.
After adding check-ins for 2023-10-15, 2023-10-16, and 2023-10-17 (via "Add past check-in"), the streak line shows "Current streak: 3 days" and "Longest streak: 3 days".

After adding check-ins for 2023-10-15, 2023-10-16, 2023-10-17, 2023-10-20, and 2023-10-21, the streak line shows "Current streak: 2 days" and "Longest streak: 3 days" because the gap on 2023-10-18 and 2023-10-19 breaks the streak.

The heatmap displays a 53-column grid for the year 2023; the cell for January 1, 2023 is empty (unfilled) and the cell for December 31, 2023 is empty (unfilled) when no check-ins exist for those dates.
After adding 15 check-ins (via "Check in today" and "Add past check-in"), the progress ring label shows "15/30" and the ring is visually half-filled.
Clicking the button "Delete check-in" on the list item for 2023-10-15 removes that entry, and if it was part of the current streak, the streak line updates to reflect the new current streak.

Reload keeps the check-in for 2023-10-15: after adding it and reloading, the heatmap still shows a filled cell for October 15, 2023, and the streak line still shows "Current streak: 1 day" if it is the only check-in.
